feature_contract.goal: Keep native full-size menu/vehicle/race independent-eye DirectGPU output bound to the live x64 OpenXR D3D11 device across compositor/session replacement by reopening imported game eyes and recreating host hold textures rather than copying stale old-device resources.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Real x64 host reopens both shared game-eye textures when the D3D11 device changes even with unchanged handles, slot, generation or format.
R23 compositor rebuilds host-owned L/R hold resources and denies stale foreign-device hold projections; failed reopen preserves classic SBS/D3D9 game rendering and inputs.
Independent WARP devices exercise matching/mismatched resource ownership and five mandatory GitHub Actions gates validate an exact final revision without claiming HMD observations.

integration_path: Native real-game D3D9 Draw/DrawIndexed builds independent D3D11 left/right game colors, imported by x64 DirectGPU host from identity-bound shared ring.

x64 host rejects cached shared game sources after D3D11 device replacement, reopens current ring handles, refreshes R23-owned left/right hold textures and routes only live-device stereo to OpenXR projection.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: WARP creates independent resources on two devices; same-device eyes allowed; R23 host reopens and recreates per-device eye resources.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Cross-device old eye, missing device or unsupported import is denied; SBS/D3D9 gameplay and FFB untouched.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: R23 main.cpp imported ring + main_r23.cpp host hold/projection use same tested resource ownership policy.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: C++ and CI only: native full-frame XR source lifetime corrected; physical menu/car/race/Quest3 runtime remains untested.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Preserves native eye opt-in, legacy SBS/DX9Ex fallback, original input/FFB and DXVK freeze.
